My mother dropped her work, and arose hurriedly, but timidly I thought.", "sha256": "c0b33ef6d92c565434e8e0cca210ac26345c0fcd05a964dec1214f99d1a0d63a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[137]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0137", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Now, Clara my dear,’ said Mr. Murdstone. ‘Recollect! control yourself, always control yourself! I could not look at her, I could not look at him, I knew quite well that he was looking at us both; and I turned to the window and looked out there, at some shrubs that were drooping their heads in the cold.", "sha256": "7552ae7ee02beb6569c4838043164782124225309dcbbd8b5f9965bb90ee953e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[139]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0139", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As soon as I could creep away, I crept upstairs.
